project.name: llmgw-billing
project.description: Billing subsystem (ADR-0007): tenant prepaid accounts with estimated reservations, price versions frozen at admission, pending-verification for unknown outcomes, voucher-idempotent recharges with reversals, and project sub-limits. All amounts are integer nano-CNY (1e-9 CNY); ledger entries post in whole micro-CNY (1000 nano) with a per-tenant carry remainder.
